name: SendTextSms
description: Sends an SMS using Twilio service
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__Twilio
fields.label: Twilio Credential
fields.description: The Twilio credential containing valid auth token and accountsId which is used to authenticate API requests.

fields.name: FromPhoneNumber
fields.label: From Phone Number
fields.description: The phone number to send the message from (Twilio number).

fields.name: ToNumber
fields.label: To Number
fields.description: The phone number to send the message to the number (Twilio number).

fields.name: MessageBody
fields.label: Message Body
fields.description: The body of the SMS message.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the response data from twilio after sending the text sms.
